badge: ONE VAULT. EVERY PART OF YOUR LIFE.
intro: Passwords, cards and authenticator codes. One calm, connected space across Windows, web and Android.
preview: A little less to remember. A lot more peace of mind.
everything: Everything you need. Nothing in your way.
encryptedDesc: Your vault contents are encrypted before being stored in the cloud. Open them with your recovery key.
syncDesc: Archive or move an account into a folder. Web and Android listen for changes; active Windows vaults refresh every 10 seconds.
togetherDesc: Keep logins, payment cards and authenticator codes in the same familiar interface.
compareDesc: Compare ways to organize your digital life. Browser features vary by provider.
localPrivacy: No sign-in needed. Your input stays in this browser and is never sent to a server.
checkDesc: Get a local estimate of length and predictable patterns. This is not a breach check.
hintWarning: Avoid names, birthdays and family details. Choose an unrelated memory cue instead.
generateDesc: Use secure random characters, a memorable phrase, or a hint with a random suffix.
unique: Use a different password for each account. Generated values are not saved.
planDesc: Start free. Choose more space for yourself or your family when you need it.
freeDesc: A simple start for your everyday essentials.
proDesc: More room for your digital life.
familyDesc: A little peace of mind for everyone.
familyAccess: Planned: optional sharing, family admin panel, member management and permissions
paymentNote: Available methods are shown at checkout.
ready: Make room for a calmer digital life.
footer: Your digital life, in one place.
cookieDesc: Essential storage keeps your sign-in and preferences. We do not load advertising or analytics trackers.
copyManual: Select and copy the password manually.
